answer_1.quote: In this work, we introduce the MORPHEUS framework for generating personalized responses.

answer_2.quote: We divide the automatic evaluation methods into three categories in order to evaluate and model the diversity, consistency, and coherence of the generated dialogues. (1) Coherence BLEU-1/2 and ROUGE-L ... (2) Diversity: Dist-1/2 ... (3) Consistency: Con.Score, Coh-Con.Score, P-Co ...

answer_4.quote: We conduct human assessments for all models. Specifically, we extract 100 data points ... and engage three well-educated annotators to rank the responses from various models.
answer_4.guideline: Our evaluation centers on readability, diversity, consistency, and coherence, prompting evaluators to rank 6 options for the five excellent model-generated responses and the factual responses.
